lines.text:
Nera kept a little distance while the relief work was handed over. Kael respected it and completed the existing homecoming. Cooperation did not erase the abandoned escort.

Nera: 'The next route is mine to choose. We can work together without sharing the rest.'
Heavy sacks over this wheel. One at a time. ... Kael? I remember you. Not now. Help Anwen find her missing people. This load is my business.
